skills.name: You Can Do It
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when using Burst Skill as long as this unit is still alive. Affects all allies. Proportionally shares damage taken. This effect is continuous. DEF ▲ 5.57% of the skill user's DEF continuously.

skills.name: Cheer Up Together
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when using Burst Skill as long as this unit is still alive. Affects this unit's cover. Proportionally shares damage taken. This effect is continuous. ■ Activates when Full Burst ends. Affects self. Continuously restores cover HP equal to 1.58% of the skill user's final max HP every second for 5 sec.

skills.name: First Winner
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Affects self. Max HP of cover ▲ 9.9% of the skill user's max HP for 20 sec. ■ Affects all allies. Damage Taken ▼ 4.87% for 10 sec.
